name: Eclipse Village
description: This village serves as a refuge for many bandits, salters, and mercenaries hiding from authorities. The village is centered around Main Street, featuring wooden and stone structures such as saloons, inns, general stores, blacksmiths, stables, and dueling grounds. The rest of the village has modest wooden homes and ranches. It is a no man’s land with no security or government; the only authority is the bandit master, Kibral, considered the quickest crossbowman in the Stravian West. They typically ride horses that are magically empowered to run faster and longer. These bandits attack caravans and travelers using crossbows and explosive arcane barrels. In the village, bards play at the saloons using unique instruments recovered from ruins. Many disagreements are resolved with a crossbow duel, some ending in death. Kibral is a formidable combatant and can use his crossbow much faster than most, shooting four bolts in the time it usually takes to shoot one. He cares more for glory and the role of a boss, or sheriff as he calls himself, than the gold and items stolen. Kibral is considered the most wanted criminal in Stravian, so many adventurers are hired to arrest or kill him. None succeeded until now.
